from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialTotal(BaseModel):
    """A single financial total metric extracted from one company's document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the filing belongs to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact text label of the line item found in the document")
    reported_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value as written in the document")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount, e.g. 'thousands', 'millions', or 'dollars'")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The date the financial statement covers")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_totals: list[CompanyFinancialTotal]
